sources.shares_2025: Assumptions: DHL delivered 3 % (2019) and 5 % (2021) of its parcels to Packstations with a 10 % target for 2025 (Statista/DHL); Hermes delivers more than 96 % at the first attempt (Hermes 2026); GLS delivers 29 % of B2C parcels in Europe to out-of-home points (GLS 2026); BPEX expects 25-30 % out of home in urban areas by 2030. FedEx/TNT: no pickup network found in the region.
sources.trend: Bounded sigmoid fitted to DHL 3 % 2019, 5 % 2021, 10 % 2025; other carriers keep the shape with their 2025 level.
sources.capacity_per_day: About 17,000 parcel lockers with more than 1.2 million compartments in Germany (Bundesnetzagentur 2024), i.e. about 70 per locker, and an assumed mean dwell time of 1.5 days.
sources.national_shops: DHL about 24,000 staffed outlets (DHL annual report 2025); DPD and GLS about 8,000-10,000 points each (DPD, GLS 2025/26); Hermes 16,000 and UPS 4,000 are assumptions to verify.
